blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We present Physicl Scenes, a high-quality artist-created and curated dataset of 6,499 3D scenes spanning household rooms, public interiors, and outdoor spaces. The dataset combines detailed geometry, physically based materials, and carefully composed environments with object- and part-level semantic annotations, providing rich, joint supervision for visual and embodied learning. We demonstrate its value as training data across inverse rendering, 3D reconstruction, scene understanding, and mobile manipulation. Across these tasks, training state-of-the-art methods with our scenes improves performance over alternative synthetic datasets. In addition, we introduce a mobile manipulation benchmark, evaluating vision-language-action models performing physical pick and place in diverse 3D scenes with realistic layouts, and using our part annotations to also score where each object is grasped. Our dataset will be released publicly to facilitate research in visual and embodied AI.
blocks.zh: Physicl Scens是一个由艺术家创造和整理的高质量数据集,由6 499个三维场景组成,跨越了家庭房间、公共室内和室外空间。 数据集结合了详细的几何,物理材料,以及精心地由物体和部分层次的语义说明所组成的环境,为视觉和有内涵的学习提供了丰富的联合监督. 我们展现出它的价值,作为跨反向渲染、三维重建、场景理解和移动操纵的培训数据。 在这些任务中,用我们的场景培训最先进的方法比其他合成数据集提高了性能。 此外,我们引入了移动操纵基准,评价了进行物理取景的视觉-语言-动作模型,并将这些模型置于各种具有现实布局的3D场景中,并使用我们的部分说明来也给每个物体的取景点打分. 我们的数据集将公开发布,以便利视觉研究和体现的AI.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Realistic 3D scenes with fine-grained ground-truth annotations are essential for learning perception and action that generalize reliably to real-world settings.
Perception models for inverse rendering, reconstruction, and scene understanding need dense ground truth, e.g . , complete geometry, materials, and instance labels. Embodied agents need interactive environments that behave like the real world, so that navigation and manipulation can be both trained and evaluated in closed-loop settings.
blocks.zh:
实事求是的3D场景带有精细的地面真实说明,对于学习可靠地向现实世界环境概括的认知和行动至关重要。
反向渲染,重建和场景理解的认知模型需要密集的地面真理,例如,完整的几何,材料,以及实例标签. 健美的代理商需要像现实世界那样行为的互动环境,这样,导航和操控就可以在闭路环境中既接受训练,又得到评价.

blocks.en:
Real-world scans [ 15 , 86 , 5 , 13 , 57 ] capture real appearance and layouts, but they are noisy and incomplete, and they cannot provide ground truth for albedo, roughness, lighting, unobserved geometry, or object parts.
Synthetic scenes provide all of these by construction, but making them realistic at scale is hard.
Procedural [ 17 , 56 ] and agentic [ 84 , 53 , 79 ] methods scale well, but their realism is bounded by hand-crafted rules or by the quality of generated 3D assets [ 81 , 82 , 14 ] .
Artist-created scenes [ 24 , 58 , 94 , 39 , 16 , 34 , 71 , 51 ] are more realistic, but manual modeling limits their scale and scene types.
blocks.zh:
真实世界扫描 [15,86,5,13,57] 捕捉真实的外观和布局,但是它们既吵又不完整,无法为反照率,粗糙度,照明度,未观测到的几何或物体部件提供地面真理.
合成场景通过构造提供了所有这些,但使其在规模上现实是很难做到的.
程序[17,56]和代理[84,53,79]方法规模很好,但其现实性受手工制作的规则或生成的立体资产的质量[81,82,14]的约束.
艺术家创作的场景[24,58,94,39,16,34,71,51]更为现实,但人工建模限制了其规模和场景类型.

blocks.en:
Learning actions adds further requirements.
Scenes must be simulation-ready, with metric scale and physical properties, and their layouts must be realistic enough for navigation.
Part-level annotations also help an agent learn where to interact with an object.
Simulation-ready artist-created scenes exist [ 39 , 34 , 71 , 52 ] but are limited in scale, and few datasets provide part-level annotations ( Tables 1 and 2 ).
As a result, realistic scenes at scale that are also simulation-ready and annotated at the part level remain scarce.
blocks.zh:
学习行动增加了其他要求。
场景必须做好模拟准备,具有度量尺度和物理属性,其布局必须足够现实,便于导航.
部分级的注释还帮助代理人学习与对象的交互位置.
模拟准备艺术家创作的场景存在[39,34,71,52],但规模有限,很少有数据集提供部分层次的说明(表1和表2).
因此,同样是模拟准备和部分说明的现实场面仍然很少。

blocks.en:
We introduce Physicl Scenes , a large-scale dataset of 6.5K artist-created 3D scenes that combines high visual fidelity, simulation-ready assets, and realistic layouts (see ). It covers a wide variety of indoor and outdoor scene types. All the scenes contain full PBR textures and rich, explicit lighting, enabling the creation of photorealistic renderings for various downstream applications (see Figure 2 ).
Physicl Scenes contains 1.6K object categories and 115K assets, several times more than any existing artist-created dataset ( Table 1 ), and has more realistic layouts, higher asset fidelity, and part-level annotations that procedurally and agentically generated datasets mostly lack ( Table 2 ).
blocks.zh:
我们引入 Physicl Scenses, 由6.5K艺术家创造的3D场景组成的大型数据集, 结合了高视觉忠诚度, 模拟准备资产, 以及现实的布局(参见). 它涵盖了多种室内外场景类型. 所有场景都包含完整的PBR纹理和丰富的,明亮的照明,能够为各种下游应用创建光现实化渲染(见图2).
图片包含 1.6K 对象类别和 115K 资产,是任何现有艺术家创建的数据集(表1)的数倍,并且具有更现实的布局,更高的资产忠诚度,以及程序和代理生成数据集大多缺乏的部分级别说明(表2).

blocks.en:
To demonstrate the benefit of Physicl Scenes for perception, we train state-of-the-art models for inverse rendering, 3D reconstruction, and 3D instance segmentation, and evaluate them zero-shot on unseen synthetic and real-world datasets.
Compared to prior synthetic datasets, Physicl Scenes reduces albedo error on real photographs by up to 47% and reconstruction Chamfer distance by up to 39%, and improves 3D instance segmentation AP by up to 5.9 points.
blocks.zh:
为了展示Physicl Scens对感知的好处,我们训练了反向渲染,3D重建,3D实例分解的先进模型,并在看不见的合成和现实世界数据集上评价它们零镜头.
与之前的合成数据集相比,Physicl Scenes将真实照片的反照率误差减少高达47%,重建的Chamfer距离减少高达39%,并将3D实例分割AP改进最多5.9分.

blocks.en:
For action, we build a mobile manipulation benchmark in which vision-language-action (VLA) models [ 31 , 9 , 91 , 19 ] follow language instructions to pick and place objects in complex indoor scenes, rather than on a single tabletop. Success also depends on where an object is grasped: a vase of flowers should be held by the vase, not a stem ( Figure 4 ). Using our part annotations, we generate ground-truth trajectories whose grasps respect such affordances, and we measure affordance accuracy, the fraction of successful grasps that contact the part the instruction implies. VLA models trained on Physicl Scenes transfer better to real-to-sim ScanNet++ environments than those trained on MolmoSpaces (12.8% vs. 9.5% success rate).
Training with affordance-aware grasps improves affordance accuracy by 8.7 and 13.5 points and success rate by 1.6 and 5.4 points for π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and MolmoBot, respectively.
blocks.zh:
为了采取行动,我们建立了一个移动操纵基准,其中视觉语言动作(VLA)模型[31,9,91,19]遵循语言指令,在复杂的室内场景中选择和放置物体,而不是放在一个单一的桌面上. 成功还取决于一个物体被抓住的地方:花瓶应该由花瓶持有,而不是树干(图4). 利用我们的部分说明,我们创造了地面真实的轨迹,其把握力尊重这种承受力,我们衡量承受力的准确性,成功把握力的一小部分与指示所暗示的那部分联系。 在Physicl Scenses上接受过培训的VLA模型比在MolmoSpaces上接受过培训的模型(12.8%对9.5%的成功率)更好地转移到了真实的ScanNet++环境中.
了解负担能力的培训使负担准确度提高了8.7分和13.5分,成功率提高了1.6分和5.4分。

blocks.en: We summarize the contributions below: • We introduce Physicl Scenes, 6.5K artist-created, simulation-ready 3D scenes with PBR textures, realistic layouts, and part-level annotations, covering indoor and outdoor spaces. • We show that training on Physicl Scenes improves zero-shot generalization to unseen and real-world data for vision tasks like inverse rendering, 3D reconstruction, and 3D instance segmentation over prior synthetic datasets. • We introduce a mobile manipulation benchmark with ground-truth trajectories in realistic indoor scenes. We add an affordance accuracy metric and affordance-aware grasp supervision derived from our part annotations. VLA models trained on Physicl Scenes transfer better to real-to-sim scenes.
blocks.zh: 我们总结以下贡献:介绍Physicl Scenses、6.5K艺术家创作的、具有PBR纹理的模拟准备的3D场景、现实的布局以及部分层面的说明,涵盖室内和室外空间。 我们显示,关于Physicl Scenes的培训改进了零射一般化,使其能为反渲染、3D重建、3D实例分解等视觉任务提供无形和真实世界的数据,从而超越以前的合成数据集。 我们在现实的室内场景中引入了带有地面真实轨迹的移动操纵基准. 我们补充了一个价格准确度的衡量标准,以及从我们部分说明中得出的价格敏锐的把握监督。 VLA模型在Physicl Scens上接受过训练,可以更好地转移到真实到镜头的场景.

blocks.en: 2.1 3D datasets
blocks.zh: 2.1 三维数据集

blocks.en:
Real-world 3D datasets are captured with handheld RGB-D sensors [ 15 , 30 , 66 ] , tripod-mounted panoramic RGB-D cameras [ 13 , 2 , 78 , 57 ] , or stationary laser scanners [ 5 , 86 ] .
Despite their realism, most scans are noisy and miss occluded regions.
Artist-made synthetic datasets, on the other hand, avoid scanning artifacts and provide exact ground truth.
Some release rendered images of professionally modeled interiors [ 58 , 94 , 22 ] , and others release 3D scenes for scene understanding and embodied agents [ 24 , 39 , 16 , 34 , 71 , 51 , 52 ] .
Both are limited in scale and scene types by the effort of manual modeling.
To overcome this, procedural methods [ 17 , 3 , 56 , 36 , 93 ] sample layouts and assets from rules or constraints, and agentic methods [ 84 , 79 , 53 ] compose scenes with LLMs from existing or generated 3D assets [ 81 , 82 , 14 , 90 , 80 , 18 ] .
However, their realism is bounded by their generation rules and asset quality.
In comparison, Physicl Scenes is more realistic than both prior artist-made and generated datasets, and larger and more diverse than the artist-made ones, with 6.5K scenes spanning household rooms, public venues, and outdoor spaces ( Tables 1 and 2 ).
blocks.zh:
真实世界3D数据集使用手持RGB-D传感器[15,30,66],三脚架全景RGB-D相机[13,2,78,57],或固定激光扫描仪[5,86]捕获.
尽管扫描具有现实性,但大多数扫描都非常吵闹,并漏掉了覆盖的区域。
而艺术家制造的合成数据集则避免扫描文物,提供准确的地面真相.
有些发布会制作专业模拟内幕的图像[58,94,22],有些发布会释放3D场景,以了解场景和体现代理[24,39,16,34,71,51,52].
由于人工建模的努力,两者在规模和场景类型上都受到限制.
为了克服这种情况,程序方法[17、3、56、36、93]从规则或制约中抽取样本布局和资产,代理方法[84、79、53]用现有的或产生的立体资产制作场景[81、82、14、90、80、18]。
然而,它们的现实主义受到其生成规则和资产质量的限制。
相比之下,Physicl Scenes比以前的艺术家制作和生成的数据集更现实,并且比艺术家制作的数据集更大,更多样化,有6.5K场景横跨家庭房间,公共场所和户外空间(表1和表2).

blocks.en: 2.2 Navigation and manipulation benchmarks
blocks.zh: 2.2 导航和操纵基准

blocks.en:
Many simulated benchmarks for embodied agents focus either on navigation [ 60 , 63 , 6 , 41 , 35 ] or on tabletop manipulation with a fixed arm [ 48 , 23 , 49 , 32 , 70 , 43 , 89 , 27 , 25 ] , which has become the standard testbed for VLA models [ 10 , 31 , 9 , 91 , 19 ] .
Existing mobile manipulation benchmarks combine the two, but often simplify one of them to keep the task tractable.
Some set the place target right next to the object [ 51 , 36 , 26 ] , so the base barely moves, while others let the robot travel farther but rely on oracle navigation, magnetic grasps, or assisted grasps [ 20 , 68 , 55 , 85 , 64 , 71 , 21 , 42 ] .
RoboCasa365 [ 52 ] comes closest to ours, with physical grasps and long-distance carries, while focusing on kitchen scenes and objects.
In comparison, our benchmark samples place targets on any other receptacle in the scene, often meters from the pick, and evaluates physical grasping and placing in held-out scenes across diverse room types.
The part annotations of Physicl Scenes further enable an affordance metric that credits a grasp only when it contacts the part the instruction implies.
blocks.zh:
许多模拟的内含物剂基准要么侧重于导航[60、63、6、41、35],要么侧重于用固定臂操纵台式计算机[48、23、49、32、70、43、89、27、25],这已成为VLA模型的标准试验床[10、31、9、91、19]。
现有的移动操纵基准将两者结合起来,但经常简化其中之一,以保持任务的可牵引性.
一些人将目标设定在物体旁边[51,36,26],因此基地几乎没有移动,而另一些人则让机器人更远地行走,但依靠甲骨文导航,磁性抓取,或协助抓取[20,68,55,85,64,71,21,42].
RoboCasa365 [52]最靠近我们的,有物理的抓取和长途携带,同时专注于厨房的场景和物品.
相比之下,我们的基准样本将目标放置在现场的任何其他贮器上,常常是在离采样处的米数上,并评估各种房间类型的实际抓取和放置。
Physicl Scenses的部分说明进一步允许一种支付量度,只有当它接触了指示所暗示的那部分时,才算入一个抓取量。

The scenes come with full PBR textures (albedo, roughness, and metallic) and explicit light emitters.
Each asset additionally carries per-part material annotations, physical properties, and metric scale.
This enables accurate physical simulation and photorealistic rendering of the scenes under different lighting conditions ( Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh:
这些场景带有完整的PBR纹理(albedo,粗糙度,和金属)和明显的光发射器.
每项资产还附有每部分材料说明、物理属性和尺度。
这有利于在不同照明条件下对场景进行准确的物理模拟和光现实化渲染(图2)。

blocks.en: 3.2 Dataset creation
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据集的创建

blocks.en: All assets and scenes in Physicl Scenes were created by professional 3D artists who were selected, trained, and equipped with dedicated tools. No content in this dataset is procedurally generated. Each object is modeled from real-world references and follows a common specification for geometry, metric scale, pivot placement and orientation, PBR materials, and naming. Before an object enters the library, it passes an automated technical validation and a human review of its visual quality, dimensions, and physical plausibility. Failed objects go back to their author until they pass.
blocks.zh: Physicl Scens中的所有资产和场景都是由专业的3D艺术家创造的,他们被选中,培训,并配备了专用工具. 本数据集中没有程序生成内容 。 每个物体都是从现实世界的参考物中建模的,并遵循了几何学,度量衡,枢轴定位和定向,PBR材料,以及命名的通用规格. 在物体进入文库之前,它会通过一个自动技术验证以及对其视觉质量,维度,物理可信度进行人文审查. 失败的物体会回到作者那里直到通过.

blocks.en:
Artists compose the scenes from this library following real-world logic rather than procedural rules, and every scene passes an architectural and a technical review.
We then make each scene simulation-ready by computing collision hulls, deriving mass and inertia from the per-part material annotations, and defining explicit lighting from the artists’ emitter materials ( Section B in the supplementary material).
blocks.zh:
艺术家们按照现实世界的逻辑而不是程序规则,从这个图书馆中编剧场景,每个场景都会通过建筑和技术评论.
然后,我们通过计算碰撞船体、从每个部分的材料说明中推导出质量和惯性以及从艺术家的发射材料(补充材料B节)中界定明亮的照明,使每个场景的模拟准备就绪。

blocks.en: 3.3 Physical interaction
blocks.zh: 3.3 物理互动

blocks.en:
We use the simulation-ready scenes to build a mobile pick-and-place task with ground-truth grasps, affordances, and episodes.
The robot follows a natural-language instruction to navigate to the target object, pick it up with a feasible grasp, navigate to the target location, and place it, using only onboard camera images and proprioception, without maps or object poses.
blocks.zh:
我们利用模拟准备的场景来构建一个具有地面真实感、承受力和场景的移动选址任务。
机器人遵循自然语言指令,向目标物体导航,以可行的抓取,向目标位置导航,并放置,仅使用机载相机图像和自控,不使用地图或物体姿势.

Table 3 : Cross-dataset generalization of single-view intrinsic decomposition. We train IntrinsicImageDiffusion, Marigold-IID, and DNF-Intrinsic on InteriorVerse [ 94 ] , SAGE-10k [ 79 ] , and Physicl Scenes, and evaluate them on datasets unseen during training.
Int. is the intensity metric of MAW, a scale-invariant MSE of grayscale albedo.
Training on Physicl Scenes improves cross-dataset generalization on most metrics.
blocks.zh:
表3:单视内在分解的跨数据集概括. 我们训练IntrinsicImageDifusion,Marigold-IID,以及DNF-Intrinsic on InternalVerse [94],SAGE-10k [79],以及Physicl Scenses,并用训练期间未见的数据集来评价它们.
Int.是MAW的强度度量衡,是一种灰度反照率的尺度-不定的MSE.
关于Physicl Scenes的培训改进了大多数指标的跨数据集概括。

blocks.en:
For each object, we sample candidate grasp poses with an antipodal grasp sampler for a parallel gripper. We keep the grasps that pass force-closure and collision checks, and verify their stability and success with simulated rollouts.
For some objects, grasping the wrong part should be avoided, e.g . , a vase of flowers should be held by the vase rather than a stem ( Figure 4 ). Using the part annotations of Physicl Scenes, we label each grasp with the object part(s) supporting contact. This gives affordance labels for the 29% of objects where the grasp location matters. For the other objects, such as a bottle, any stable grasp is acceptable.
blocks.zh:
对于每个物体,我们用反球状的抓取器来取样候选的抓取物,以平行抓取物。 我们掌握着通过武力关闭和碰撞检查,并通过模拟推出来验证其稳定性和成功性。
对于某些物体来说,应当避免抓住错误的部分,例如,花瓶应当由花瓶而不是茎来持有花瓶(图4 )。 使用 Physicl Scens 的部分说明,我们用支持接触的对象部分给每个抓取标记 。 这使得29%的物体在抓取位置上具有重要性时的承受力标签. 对于其他物体,如瓶子,任何稳定的抓取都是可以接受的.

blocks.en: Placing an object means putting it on a surface of another asset, e.g . , a table or shelf. For each such asset, we group the upward-facing faces of its mesh by height, which gives one surface per level, e.g . , each board of an open shelf. A place target is a pose sampled on such a surface where the footprint of the object fits.
blocks.zh: 将一个物体放置在另一个资产的表面,例如,桌子或架子上。 对于每一个这样的资产,我们按高度将网状的上方面组合起来,每层都有一个表面,例如,一个开阔的架板的每个板。 地点目标是指在物体足迹符合的表面取样的姿势。

blocks.en: To compute the base paths to the target object and to the place target, we rasterize the collision shapes of the scene into a 2D occupancy map and dilate it by the robot radius, so that every free cell is collision-free for the robot base. We then plan the shortest path over the free cells.
blocks.zh: 为了计算目标物体和地点目标的基准路径,我们把场景的碰撞形状拉成2D占用图,并在机器人半径旁放大,这样每个自由细胞对机器人基地来说都是无碰撞的. 然后,我们计划最短的路径 在自由细胞。

blocks.en: An episode is one expert demonstration, recorded as a natural-language instruction, wrist and base camera views, and robot actions. Using the grasps, place targets, and navigation paths above, we plan the navigation and manipulation actions under the robot’s kinematic and dynamic constraints, execute each plan as a closed-loop rollout in MuJoCo, and keep only the episodes that succeed. In total, we generate 30,084 episodes with 10M frames (139.9 hours of simulation) in a subset of 1,155 scenes and 2,052 objects, following the train/validation/test scene split of Physicl Scenes.
blocks.zh: 一个插曲是一次专家演示,记录为自然语教学,腕部和基部镜头观看,以及机器人动作. 我们利用上面的抓住、放置目标和导航路径,在机器人的动能和动态制约下规划导航和操纵行动,在穆乔科执行每个计划,作为闭路推出,并且只保留成功的事件。 我们总共生成了30,084集,其中10M帧(139.9小时模拟)在1,155场景和2,052个物体的子集中,遵循Physicl Scenes的列车/验证/测试场景分割.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate Physicl Scenes on four tasks: inverse rendering, 3D instance segmentation, 3D reconstruction, and mobile manipulation. For each task, we train state-of-the-art models on Physicl Scenes or on prior synthetic datasets, and compare how well they generalize to unseen data, including real-world datasets. For mobile manipulation, we fine-tune VLA models and evaluate them on held-out Physicl Scenes scenes and on real-to-sim environments. The supplementary material provides additional benchmarks on Physicl Scenes for inverse rendering and monocular depth and normal estimation.
blocks.zh: 我们评价 Physicl Scenses 的四个任务:反渲染,3D实例分割,3D重建,移动操纵. 对于每一项任务,我们都会在Physicl Scenses或之前的合成数据集上训练最先进的模型,并比较它们在多大程度上将通用到看不见的数据,包括现实世界的数据集. 对于移动操纵,我们微调VLA模型,并在被搁置的Physicl Scenes场景和真实到图像环境中对其进行评价. 补充材料为反向渲染、单倍深度和正常估计提供了额外基准。

blocks.en: 4.1 Inverse rendering
blocks.zh: 4.1 反射

blocks.en: For each scene, we render 100 images with Blender Cycles from camera poses sampled in the walkable regions, together with albedo, roughness, metallic, normal, and depth maps. We randomize the lighting per frame ( e.g . , lamps on/off and day/night) and drop frames in which the camera is too close to the geometry or sees too little of the scene.
blocks.zh: 对于每个场景,我们用相机制作100幅图像,用Blender Cycle从可行走区域取样,以及反照率、粗糙度、金属、正常和深度图。 我们随机抽取每个帧的灯光(如灯光在/关闭和日/夜)和投放帧,其中相机太接近几何或很少看到场景.

blocks.en:
Figure 5 : Qualitative cross-dataset comparison of intrinsic decomposition. Each method is trained on InteriorVerse [ 94 ] , SAGE-10k [ 79 ] , or Physicl Scenes, and evaluated on datasets unseen during training: Hypersim [ 58 ] , Infinigen Indoors [ 56 ] , and MAW [ 74 ] (real photos).
The model trained on Physicl Scenes reconstructs cleaner albedos ( e.g . , less lighting or shadow baked in) and gives roughness and metallic maps closer to the ground truth, even under challenging lighting.
blocks.zh:
图5:内在分解的定性跨数据集比较. 每种方法都经过了IsperVerse [94],SAGE-10k [79] 或 Physicl Scens, 并在培训期间未见的数据集上进行评估:Hypersim [58],Infinigen室内 [56],和MAW [74] (真实照片)。
接受过Physicl Scenses培训的模型重建了更清洁的反照率(例如,较少的照明或阴影烘烤),并给粗糙度和金属图贴近地面真相,即使在挑战性的照明下也是如此.

blocks.en: We train three diffusion-based intrinsic decomposition models, IntrinsicImageDiffusion [ 37 ] , Marigold-IID [ 33 ] , and DNF-Intrinsic [ 92 ] , on Physicl Scenes and compare them with the same models trained on InteriorVerse [ 94 ] , a widely used dataset, and SAGE-10k [ 79 ] , which is larger but only partly PBR-textured.
blocks.zh: 我们在Physicl Scees上培训了三种基于扩散的内在分解模型,即IntrinsicImageDifmation[37],Marigold-IID[33],以及DNF-Intrinsic[92],并将它们与广泛使用的数据集InternalVerse[94]和SAGE-10k[79]的相同模型进行比较,后者更大,但只有部分PBR的文本。

blocks.en: We evaluate the models zero-shot on three unseen datasets: the synthetic Hypersim [ 58 ] (albedo si-PSNR and LPIPS) and Infinigen Indoors [ 56 ] (albedo si-PSNR and roughness and metallic RMSE), and MAW [ 74 ] , real photographs with measured albedo, where we report its intensity metric, the scale-invariant MSE of grayscale albedo over the annotated regions.
blocks.zh: 我们从三个未见数据集中评估模型的零射线:合成Hypersim [58](Albedo si-PSNR和LPIPS)和Infinigen室内(Albedo si-PSNR和粗糙度及金属RMSE),以及MAW [74],真实照片,有测量反照率,我们报告其强度度度度度,灰色比例反照率在附加说明的区域上的比例-不定的MSE。

blocks.en: Table 3 shows that models trained on Physicl Scenes generalize better than those trained on InteriorVerse or SAGE-10k, with the lowest roughness error on Infinigen Indoors and the lowest MAW intensity error for all three models. We attribute this to the diverse part materials and explicit scene lighting, which help models separate lighting from materials. In Figure 5 , the model trained on SAGE-10k bakes the dark lighting into the albedo, whereas the model trained on Physicl Scenes does not.
blocks.zh: 表3显示,在Physicl Scenes上接受过培训的模型比在InternalVerse或SAGE-10k上接受过培训的模型概括性更好,Infinigen室内的粗糙度差最小,所有三种模型的MAW强度差最低. 我们将此归因于不同的部分材料和清晰的场景照明,这有助于模型将照明与材料分开. 在图5中,接受过SAGE-10k训练的模型将暗光烤成反照率,而接受过Physicl Scenes训练的模型则没有.

blocks.en: 4.2 3D instance segmentation
blocks.zh: 4.2 3D 实例分割

blocks.en: Table 4 : Zero-shot class-agnostic 3D instance segmentation. Each method is trained on the GT instance masks of ScanNet200 [ 59 ] , alone or joined with one synthetic set. Training on ScanNet200 and Physicl Scenes combined generalizes best on most metrics.
blocks.zh: 表4:零镜头类可知性3D实例分解. 每种方法都用ScanNet200[59]的GT实例口罩进行单独训练或与一套合成的口罩结合。 关于ScanNet200和Physicl Scenes的培训结合了大多数衡量标准的最佳概括。

blocks.en: To emulate real scans with occlusions and missing regions, we back-project the depth maps of rendered images into 3D point clouds for training. We also add ScanNet200 [ 59 ] to the training set as a source of real-world data.
blocks.zh: 为了模拟真实的扫描 与隔离和缺失区域, 我们背面投射 深度地图 渲染图像 成3D点云 训练。 我们还在培训集中增加了ScanNet200[59]作为真实世界数据的来源.

blocks.en: We train Mask3D [ 62 ] and PTv3 [ 76 ] for class-agnostic instance segmentation on the ground-truth instance masks of ScanNet200 combined with one synthetic dataset (3D-FRONT [ 24 ] , SAGE-10k [ 79 ] , or Physicl Scenes). The supplementary material shows example training scans, open-vocabulary results, and qualitative examples.
blocks.zh: 我们训练Mask3D [62] 和PTv3 [76] 在ScanNet 200的地面真象口罩上进行类不可知实例分解,并配有一个合成数据集(3D-FRONT [24],SAGE-10k [79],或Physicl Scenes)。 补充材料展示了培训扫描、开放式投票结果和定性实例。

blocks.en: We evaluate zero-shot on ScanNet++ [ 86 ] and Replica [ 66 ] and report AP, AP 50 , and AP 25 .
blocks.zh: 我们在ScanNet++[86]和复制[66]上评价零射线,并报告AP、AP50和AP25。

blocks.en: Table 4 shows that adding Physicl Scenes to ScanNet200 improves both models over ScanNet200 alone and beats the other synthetic datasets on all metrics but PTv3’s ScanNet++ AP. Realistic and diverse synthetic scenes thus help 3D instance segmentation generalize, and the choice of synthetic dataset matters.
blocks.zh: 表4显示,将 Physicl Scenses 添加到 ScanNet 200 中, 单靠 ScanNet 200 改进了两种模型, 并击败了除了 PTv3 的 ScanNet ++ 以外的所有公制中的其他合成数据集 AP. (英语). 因此,现实和多样的合成场景有助于3D实例分割的概括,以及合成数据集事项的选择。

blocks.en: 4.3 3D reconstruction
blocks.zh: 4.3 三维重建

blocks.en: Table 5 : Zero-shot 3D reconstruction. Each scene is reconstructed from 8 input views. We compute the 3D metrics for the GT observed parts. Physicl Scenes provides clean 3D supervision for reconstruction with accurate geometry, producing the lowest Chamfer distances.
blocks.zh: 表5:零射三维重建. 每个场景从8个输入视图重建. 我们计算了GT观测到的部分的3D度量度. Physicl Scens为重建提供清洁的3D监理,精确的几何,产生最小的Chamfer距离.

blocks.en:
Figure 6 : Qualitative 3D reconstruction across training sets. FineRecon on a Replica [ 66 ] scene and GenRecon on a ScanNet++ [ 86 ] scene, each reconstructed from 8 input views, with the method trained on 3D-FRONT [ 24 ] , SAGE-10k [ 79 ] , or Physicl Scenes. Our dataset yields sharper, more complete reconstructions.
Predictions are clipped to the ground truth’s floor plan, removing geometry outside the room.
blocks.zh:
图6:各类培训的定性立体重建。 FineRecon on a Replica [66] scene and GenRecon on a ScanNet++ [86] scene, 各自从8个输入视图重建,其方法训练为3D-FRONT [24],SAGE-10k [79],或Physicl Scenses. 我们的数据集能更清晰更完整的重建
预测被剪切到地面真相的地板上,去掉房间外的几何形状.

blocks.en: Complete ground-truth geometry makes synthetic scenes well suited to train 3D reconstruction models. We render the input views with our pipeline and supervise with the ground-truth geometry and materials.
blocks.zh: 完整的地面真实几何使得合成场景非常适合训练3D重建模型. 我们用管道提出投入意见,用地面真实几何和材料进行监督。

blocks.en: We train FineRecon [ 65 ] and GenRecon [ 61 ] on 3D-FRONT [ 24 ] , SAGE-10k [ 79 ] , or Physicl Scenes.
blocks.zh: 我们训练FineRecon [65] 和GenRecon [61] 在3D -FRONT [24],SAGE-10k [79],或Physicl Scenses。

blocks.en: We evaluate the models zero-shot on the real-world ScanNet++ [ 86 ] and Replica [ 66 ] datasets from eight input views that uniformly cover each scene, ignoring regions that no input view sees.
blocks.zh: 我们评价真实世界ScanNet++[86]和复制[66]数据集上的模型零镜头,它们来自八个输入视图,统一覆盖每个场景,忽略了没有输入视图看到的区域.

blocks.en: Table 5 shows that training on Physicl Scenes gives the lowest Chamfer distance for both models on both datasets and the best results on most other metrics. We attribute this to the high-fidelity, artist-modeled geometry and assets of Physicl Scenes across 1.6K object categories ( Tables 1 and 2 ), which give the models better shape priors and lead to sharper and more complete reconstructions ( Figure 6 ). In contrast, 3D-FRONT contains mostly large furniture.
blocks.zh: 表5显示,关于Physicl Scenes的培训为两个数据集的模型提供了最小的Chamfer距离,并为大多数其他衡量标准提供了最佳结果。 我们将此归因于Physicl Scens在1.6K对象类别(表1和表2)中的高真度、艺术家模型几何学和资产,这使得模型的形状前兆更好,并导致更尖锐和更完整的重建(图6)。 相比之下,3D-FRONT主要包含大型家具.

blocks.en: 4.4 Mobile manipulation
blocks.zh: 4.4 移动操纵

blocks.en: We evaluate two settings. The first is our mobile pick-and-place benchmark ( Section 3.3 ) on the held-out Physicl Scenes test scenes (43 scenes and 222 episodes), where policies train on the demonstrations of the training scenes. The second tests zero-shot transfer to real-world scans with mobile pick-only on the ScanNet++ real-to-sim environments of SimNet++ [ 50 ] (35 scenes and 183 episodes), where we compare VLAs trained on Physicl Scenes or on MolmoSpaces [ 36 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们评估两个设置。 首先是我们关于被搁置的Physicl Scenes试验场景(43场景和222集)的移动选址基准(3.3节),其中政策对训练场景的演示进行了训练。 第二次测试在SimNet++的ScanNet++的真对映环境中只使用移动拾取方式进行零镜头传输到现实世界扫描,[50](35场和183集),我们比较了在Physicl Scenses或MolmoSpaces上训练的VLA[36].

blocks.en: Table 6 : Mobile manipulation benchmark. VLA models are fine-tuned on Physicl Scenes and evaluated on held-out test scenes. Even the best model, π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , succeeds in only 15.2% of the episodes, leaving large room for improvement. Time is averaged over successful episodes.
blocks.zh: 表6:移动操纵基准。 VLA模型在Physicl Scense上进行微调,并在被搁置的测试场景上进行评估. 即使是最佳的模特, ~ 0.5\pi_{0.5}, 只在15.2%的剧集中成功, 留下了很大的改进余地. 时间平均于成功事件。

blocks.en: We fine-tune state-of-the-art VLA models, X-VLA [ 91 ] , GR00T N1.7 [ 9 ] , π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [ 31 ] , and MolmoBot [ 19 ] , on the Physicl Scenes training episodes.
blocks.zh: 我们微调最新VLA模式,X-VLA [91],GR00T N1.7 [9], 0.5\pi_{0.5}[31],以及MolmoBot [19],在Physicl Scenes训练节目上.

blocks.en:
The robot starts near the target object, and we report the success rate averaged over three seeds per episode, along with the partial goals Reach (the object), Pick, and Surface (reaching the placement surface). A grasp succeeds if the object is lifted 5 cm and held for 2 s. For objects with affordance labels, we also report affordance accuracy, the fraction of successful grasps that contact the intended part.
For pick and place, our scenes and episodes support both learned navigation policies and expert navigation planners. Popular VLAs such as π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and MolmoBot, however, are built for manipulation within a short base move of the object, not for long-distance navigation. Trained end-to-end on our full episodes, they never reached a distant placement goal (0% success). We therefore evaluate a hybrid setup, following existing mobile manipulation benchmarks [ 55 , 85 , 64 ] : the policy moves the base and arm to pick and place the object, and our expert planner handles only the long-distance navigation in between.
blocks.zh:
机器人从目标物体附近开始,我们报告每集成功率平均在3个种子上,还有部分目标Reach(对象),Pick,和Surface(影响放置表面). 如果物体被抬起5厘米,并持有2秒,则抓取成功。 对于带有价格标签的物体,我们也报告价格的准确性,成功抓住的一小部分与预定部分相连。
就选址而言,我们的场景和事件既支持学习的导航政策,也支持专业的导航规划者。 然而,普通的VLA,如  0.5\pi_{0.5}和MolmoBot,都是在物体的短基移动范围内为操纵而建造的,而不是用于长途导航. 他们从未达到遥远的安置目标(成功率为0%)。 因此,我们按照现有的移动操纵基准[55、85、64]评估混合设置: 政策移动基础和手臂 来选择和放置物体, 我们的专家规划员只处理长途导航 在两者之间。

blocks.en: Table 7: Mobile manipulation transfer to real-to-sim ScanNet++ [ 86 ] scenes. VLAs trained on Physicl Scenes outperform those trained on MolmoSpaces in terms of success rate, demonstrating better zero-shot transfer to more realistic environments.
blocks.zh: 表7:移动操纵转移至真对映ScanNet++[86]场景. 接受过Physicl Scenes培训的VLA在成功率方面超过了接受过MolmoSpaces培训的VLA,显示出更好的零射转会到更现实的环境.

blocks.en: Table 8: Ablation on training with affordance labels for mobile picking. With affordance labels, the models can better predict feasible grasps and improve task success.
blocks.zh: 表8: 使用工资标签进行流动采摘的培训。 有了负担的标签,模型就可以更好地预测可行的把握和改进任务的成功。

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Closed-loop mobile picking in ScanNet++ real-to-sim scenes. Each column shows a real ScanNet++ photo and the simulated frames of a successful rollout by π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} trained on Physicl Scenes, in a scene provided by SimNet++ [ 50 ] .
blocks.zh: 图7:ScanNet++中闭路移动取景. 每个栏目都显示一张真实的ScanNet++照片,以及在SimNet++[50]提供的场景中,通过 Physicl Scenes 训练成功推出的模拟帧.

blocks.en: Table 6 shows that although VLA models are effective on tabletop manipulation, they still struggle with long-horizon pick and place in complex, unseen scenes. In real-to-sim transfer, training on Physicl Scenes improves both VLAs over training on MolmoSpaces ( Table 7 and Figure 7 ).
blocks.zh: 表6显示,虽然VLA模型在桌面操纵上是有效的,但是它们仍然与长视采样并置于复杂,看不见的场景中挣扎. 在实到实的转让中,Physicl Scenes培训比MolmoSpace培训(表7和图7)改进了VLA。

blocks.en: Table 8 compares π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and MolmoBot trained with and without affordance supervision, on picking the 61 objects with affordance labels (292 episodes). Affordance supervision improves both affordance accuracy and success rate, suggesting that it leads to more consistent grasps that are easier to execute.
blocks.zh: 表8比较了0.5\pi=0.5}和MolmoBot经过或不负担监管的培训,选择61个带有负担标签的物体(292集)。 负担的监督既能提高负担的准确度,又能提高成功率,这表明这会导致更一致的把握,更容易执行。

blocks.en: 5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 限制

blocks.en:
Physicl Scenes is created and reviewed by artists, so it is more costly to extend than procedurally or agentically generated datasets.
Moreover, the scenes are static and all objects are simulated as rigid bodies, so they do not capture dynamics such as moving people, or deformable objects such as cloth.
For manipulation, our benchmark covers pick and place, but not tasks such as opening drawers or more abstract ones such as cleaning up a table.
Its affordance labels are also task independent, although the part to grasp can depend on the instruction, e.g . , a mug is held by its handle to drink from but by its body to put away.
blocks.zh:
Physicl Scens由艺术家创建和审查,因此扩展比程序或代理生成的数据集成本更高.
此外,场景是静态的,所有物体都模拟为刚性的身体,因此它们不捕捉动人等动态,也不捕捉布等变形物体.
对于操控,我们的基准覆盖采摘和放置,但不包括打开抽屉等任务,也不包括清理桌子等更为抽象的任务.
其负担的标签也是独立的,尽管要抓住的部分可以取决于指示,例如,一个杯子被它的手柄握着,要喝,但被身体收起来.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We presented Physicl Scenes, 6.5K artist-created, simulation-ready 3D scenes with full PBR materials, realistic layouts, and part-level annotations.
Training on Physicl Scenes improves generalization to unseen and real-world data for multiple tasks.
Our mobile manipulation benchmark evaluates action models on navigation and manipulation in diverse indoor scenes.
In the future, we hope Physicl Scenes will enable research that bridges perception and action in complex 3D environments, such as interactive 3D scene generation, action-conditioned world models, and embodied agents with spatial memory.
blocks.zh:
我们展示了Physicl Scens, 6.5K艺术家创建的, 模拟准备的3D场景, 配有完整的PBR材料, 现实的布局, 以及部分级别的说明。
关于Physicl Scens的培训改进了对多种任务的无形和现实世界数据的概括。
我们的移动操纵基准评价了各种室内场景中导航和操纵的行动模式.
我们希望未来,Physicl Scenses能够使研究在复杂的3D环境中连接感知和行动,如交互式3D场景生成,行动有条件的世界模型,以及带有空间记忆的内含物剂.

We used VLMs to classify each asset into a category and build the taxonomy. Qwen3.8-27B was the judge that scored layout realism, asset fidelity, and aesthetics in Tables 1 and 2 . 我们用VLM将每个资产归为一类,建立分类学. Quen3.8-27B在表1和表2中评分为布局现实主义,资产忠诚主义,美学. 克劳德 守则协助撰写数据处理、培训和评价守则。 提交人对这一切进行了审查和测试。 克劳德协助编辑了文法,措辞和清晰度的文本. 提交人检查了每一份编辑和参考资料,并对论文的内容承担全部责任。

blocks.en: Appendix B Dataset creation details
blocks.zh: 附录B 数据集创建详情

blocks.en: Artists compose the scenes from the asset library, starting from a brief for a given type of space, so that layout, object placement, scale, and material use follow real-world logic rather than procedural rules. A reviewer checks each concept against architectural criteria and follows the scene through detailing. Each scene also receives traces of human presence, based on a short scenario of the life that could take place there, so that it does not look artificially clean. A final technical check verifies every scene against the specification. Each scene is stored as a single GLB file with a semantic object hierarchy and PBR textures, in which every object is a separate mesh at metric scale.
blocks.zh: 艺术家从资产库中编集场景,从特定类型空间的简介开始,这样布局,对象布置,尺度,以及材料使用都遵循现实世界逻辑而不是程序规则. 一名审查员对照建筑标准检查每个概念,并跟踪现场进行详细介绍。 每个场景也接收到人类存在的痕迹,根据可以在那里发生的生命的短暂情景,这样它就不会被人为地看清. 最终技术检查 根据规格核实每个场景 每个场景作为单一的GLB文件存储,带有语义对象等级和PBR纹理,其中每个对象都是一个单独的网格,以度量尺度表示.

blocks.en:
We extract the assets and the scene shell ( e.g . , walls and ceilings) from each scene and compose a scene graph of the physical relations between assets, such as support and attachment.
We classify the assets into categories with a vision-language model (VLM) and have human annotators verify the categorization. To make the scenes physically simulatable, we compute collision hulls for the assets and the scene shell with CoACD [ 73 ] . Using the per-part material annotations of the artist meshes, we assign physical properties ( e.g . , density) to each part, from which we derive the mass and inertia of each asset. We also use the artists’ annotations of emitter materials to define the explicit lighting of each scene, which, combined with the full PBR textures, enables photorealistic rendering. The result is a set of simulation-ready scenes for robotic manipulation and other physics-based tasks.
blocks.zh:
我们从每个场景中提取资产和场景外壳(如墙壁和天花板),并绘制资产间物理关系的场景图,如支持和附加.
我们将这些资产分类为具有视觉语言模型(VLM)的类别,并让人类注释者核实这一分类。 为了让场景在物理上具有模拟性,我们用CoACD计算出资产和场景外壳的碰撞船体[73]. 使用艺术家间隙的每段材料说明,我们给每个部分分配物理属性(例如密度),我们从中得出每个资产的质量与惯性. 我们还利用艺术家对发射材料的说明来定义每个场景的明亮光线,这些光线与完整的PBR纹理相结合,可以进行光现实化渲染. 结果是一套模拟准备场景,用于机器人操纵和其他基于物理的任务.

blocks.en: Appendix C Dataset comparison details
blocks.zh: 附录C 数据集比较细节

blocks.en:
We compute the statistics in Tables 1 and 2 on the data each dataset releases, which can be smaller than what its paper describes.
SpatialGen releases 48 of the 57K rooms in its paper, and GRUtopia releases 99 scenes of a collection that its paper puts at about 100K.
blocks.zh:
我们计算表1和表2中每一数据集发布的数据统计数据,这些数据可能小于其论文所述数字。
空间 Gen在其论文中释放了57K房间中的48个,GRUtopia发布了99个场景的集合,其论文给出了约100K的集合.

blocks.en:
We count distinct rooms, so a room shipped in several styles counts once.
RoboCasa365 ships 2,500 kitchen scenes that restyle 60 floor plans, so we count 60 rooms and measure the floor area of each plan once.
GRUtopia annotates rooms only in the 30 home scenes of its benchmark, so we count its 321 rooms on those scenes.
For 3D-FRONT, we use the 18,968 furnished rooms reported in its paper, while its floor area covers the whole houses, including unfurnished rooms.
We count each Hypersim scene as one room.
For ease of computation, we treat each Physicl Scenes outdoor scene as a single room.
blocks.zh:
我们数不同的房间, 所以用几种风格运送的房间 算一次。
RoboCasa365号轮船2500个厨房场景,重塑了60个楼层图案,因此我们数了60个房间,并测量了每个楼层图案的面积一次.
GRUtopia只在其基准的30个主场景中提供房间,所以我们计算出这些场景上的321个房间。
对3D-FRONT来说,我们使用其报纸上报道的18,968个家具房间,而其地板面积覆盖整个房屋,包括未装修的房间。
我们把每个Hypersim场景算为一个房间。
为了便于计算,我们把每个Physicl室外场景作为单间.

blocks.en:
Floor area is the area of the modeled floor surfaces, summed over all scenes.
For Physicl Scenes, the residential, public indoor, and outdoor scenes contribute 162K, 459K, and 2.70M m 2 , respectively.
Outdoor scenes model large ground surfaces, so they account for most of the total. However, even without outdoor scenes, the indoor scenes still cover 621K m 2 , which is larger than the floor area of other datasets in Table 1 .
blocks.zh:
地板面积是模拟地板表面的面积,概括于所有场景.
对于Physicl Scens,住宅,公共室内和室外场景分别贡献了162K,459K和2.70M m 2.
户外场景模式为大型地面表面,因此占了总数的大多数. 然而,即使没有室外场景,室内场景仍覆盖了621K m 2,比表1中其他数据集的地板面积更大.

blocks.en:
An instance is a placed object, and an asset is a distinct 3D model behind one or more instances.
For 3D-FRONT, we count the placed 3D-FUTURE furniture models, 14,051 in the release, close to the 13,151 reported in its paper.
We exclude the per-house fittings, such as kitchen cabinets, doors, and windows, which carry no object category.
blocks.zh:
一个实例是放置的对象,一个资产是一个或多个实例背后的鲜明的三维模型.
对于3D-FRONT,我们计算出放置的3D-Future家具模型,14,051在发行时,接近其论文中报告的13,151.
我们排除了每栋房子的配件,例如厨房的柜子,门和窗户,它们没有物品类别.

blocks.en:
We rate the scenes with Qwen3.8-27B, with thinking disabled.
For each dataset with 3D scenes, we sample 20 scenes per room type and render each scene with the same cameras and lighting.
A top-down view from 3.5 times the wall height, with the ceiling removed, shows the layout.
An eye-level view at 1.55 m with a 100 ∘ horizontal field of view, taken from the corner that sees the most furniture, shows the objects.
For datasets that release only images, we use one released frame per scene.
The VLM rates each image from 1 to 5 with the prompts in Figure A8 , giving its reason before the score, and we report the mean over all rated images.
Layout realism is rated on the top-down view, and asset fidelity and aesthetics on the eye-level view.
Datasets that release only images have no top-down view, so we do not report layout realism for them.
blocks.zh:
我们用Qwen3.8-27B来评分这些场景,思维残疾.
对于每个有3D场景的数据集,我们每个房间类型对20场景进行抽样,并用相同的摄像机和照明来渲染每个场景.
从墙体高度3.5倍的自上而下视图,天花板被移除,显示布局.
视平面为1.55米,平面为100 QQ水平视场,取自看到家具最多的角落,显示物体.
对于只发布图像的数据集,我们每个场景使用一个发布的帧.
VLM将每个图像从1到5的评分,在图A8中提示,在得分前给出其理由,我们报告所有评分图像的平均值.
布局现实主义被评为自上而下的视图,资产忠贞和美学被评为眼层视图.
仅发布图像的数据集没有自上而下的视图,因此我们不会为它们报告布局现实主义.

blocks.en: Appendix E Experiment details
blocks.zh: 附录E 实验细节

blocks.en: E.1 Inverse rendering
blocks.zh: E.1 反射

blocks.en:
We provide additional benchmarks for single-view and scene-level inverse rendering methods on the Physicl Scenes test set, using their released code and weights without fine-tuning. The results are shown in Section E.1 .
We intentionally include both day and night lighting, so that the methods face both sunlight through the windows and scenes lit only by lamps.
blocks.zh:
我们为Physicl Scenes测试集上的单视图和场景级反向渲染方法提供了额外的基准,使用其释放的代码和重量而不进行微调. 结果见E.1节。
我们有意将白天和晚上的照明都包括在内,以便这些方法既通过窗户面对阳光,也面对只用灯光点亮的场景。

blocks.en:
For the single-view methods, we take three views per lighting from each of the indoor test scenes, 1,820 frames in total at 640 × \times 480.
We skip views that are mostly over- or underexposed, too close to the geometry, or show fewer than three objects.
blocks.zh:
对于单景法,我们从每个室内试验场景的光线上,每盏光线上摄取3个视图,总共1,820帧,共640×\时速480.
我们跳过多数是过度或未充分暴露、太接近几何或显示不到三个物体的视图。

blocks.en:
For the scene-level methods, we take 15 test scenes, one per scene type, 8 with day and 7 with night lighting.
Each scene has 180 input views and 20 held-out views. We query the recovered materials at the surfaces seen by the held-out views, so the scores measure the materials of the whole scene rather than how well a method fits its input views.
Prior scene-level methods, such as FIPT [ 75 ] , IRIS [ 46 ] , and Intrinsic Image Fusion [ 38 ] , evaluate on the four synthetic scenes of FIPT, built from the rendering resources of Bitterli [ 8 ] , so our scene-level benchmark covers almost four times as many scenes and a much wider range of scene types.
All methods receive the ground-truth camera poses.
FIPT, IRIS, NeILF++, and Intrinsic Image Fusion also assume the ground-truth mesh as input, and we evaluate GenRecon both with and without it. We also use the ground-truth mesh for MVInverse to propagate the prediction to held-out views.
blocks.zh:
对于场景层面的方法,我们取15个测试场景,每个场景类型1个,8个有白天,7个有夜间照明.
每个场景有180个输入视图和20个搁置视图. 我们询问被搁置的视图所看到的表面的回收材料,所以得分量了整个场景的材料,而不是一个方法是否适合其输入视图。
之前的场景级别方法,如FIPT[75],IRIS[46],以及Intrinsic Image Fusion[38],评价FIPT的四个合成场景,由Bitterli的渲染资源[8]所建,因此我们的场景级别基准覆盖了近4倍的场景和范围更广的场景类型.
所有的方法都接收到地面真实的摄像机
FIPT, IRIS, NELF++, 和Intrinsic Image Fusion 也把地面真实的网格作为输入, 我们评价GenRecon 是否有它. 我们还利用MVINVERS的地面真人网,将预测传播给持有的观点。

blocks.en:
We score albedo in sRGB space, and roughness and metallic in linear space, over the pixels that do not show emitters, windows, or transparent surfaces.
For si-PSNR, we fit one scale per channel in linear space before computing the PSNR.
Even with the ground-truth mesh, the scene-level methods struggle to recover accurate materials, since the complex lighting of the scenes is hard to disentangle from the materials.
For example, the lamps of Physicl Scenes are light sources inside the fixtures rather than emissive surfaces, so FIPT finds no emitter at night and bakes the lamp glow into the albedo.
NeILF++, on the other hand, models the lighting as an incident light field that depends on position. We observe that at night, the appearance of the materials is absorbed by the lighting, leaving a mostly uniform albedo.
blocks.zh:
我们在SRGB空间中得反照率,在线性空间中得粗糙度和金属度,在不显示发射器,窗口或透明表面的像素上得分.
对于si-PSNR,在计算PSNR之前,我们在线性空间中每个通道安装一个比例尺.
即使有了地面真实的网格,场景层面的方法也难以回收准确的材料,因为场景的复杂照明很难与材料分开.
例如,Physicl Scenes的灯光是固定装置内部的光源,而不是发射表面,因此FIPT在夜间找不到发射器,将灯光烤成反照率.
另一方面,NeILF++将照明作为取决于位置的事件光场进行模型化. 我们观察到,在夜间,材料的外观被照明吸收,留下了大部分统一的反照率.

blocks.en: E.2 3D instance segmentation
blocks.zh: E.2 3D 实例分割

blocks.en:
Figure A4 shows training scans from Physicl Scenes.
For each scene, we back-project the depth maps of the rendered views into one point cloud and keep one point per 1 cm voxel. Mask3D and PTv3 voxelize this cloud further to 2 cm.
Each placed object is one instance mask, the pieces of a door or window ( e.g . , frames, handles) are merged into one instance, and walls, floors, and ceilings carry no instance.
As in real scans, occluded surfaces, such as the floor under furniture, have no points.
blocks.zh:
图A4显示了来自Physicl Scens的训练扫描.
每一个场景,我们背面投影 深度地图 所给出的视图 成一个点云 并保持一个点每1厘米阴道。 蒙斯克3D和PTv3将这种云蒸发到2厘米.
每个放置的对象都是一个实例面具,一个门或窗口的片段(如帧,柄)被合并成一个实例,墙壁,地板和天花板没有实例.
与真实扫描一样,如家具下方的地板等斜面没有分数.

blocks.en:
Figure A4 : Training scans for class-agnostic 3D instance segmentation on Physicl Scenes. Each column shows one scene as the back-projected point cloud at the 2 cm voxel size used in training, in its rendered color (top) and with its ground-truth instance masks (bottom), where walls, floors, and ceilings are gray.
Points more than 2 m above the floor are hidden for display.
blocks.zh:
图A4:Physicl Scenes上的班级不可知性3D实例分解的培训扫描。 每个栏目都显示一个场景,作为训练中使用的2厘米阴道大小的反射点云,其变色(顶部)和地面真实的口罩(底部),墙壁、地板和天花板是灰色的。
地上2米以上的点被隐藏起来展示.

blocks.en: Each training sample comes from ScanNet200 or the synthetic dataset with equal probability. PTv3 trains for 150k steps with a batch size of 16, and Mask3D for 150k steps with a batch size of 12. We select the checkpoint on the validation sets of the training datasets and never on ScanNet++ or Replica. We train both models class-agnostically. Every instance carries the same label, so the class head of each query only predicts whether the query is an object or no object, instead of one of the 200 ScanNet200 classes.
blocks.zh: 每个训练样本都来自ScanNet200或概率相等的合成数据集. PTv3次列车为150k级,分批规模为16节,Mask3D次为150k级,分批规模为12节. 我们在训练数据集的验证组上选择检查点,并且永远不要在ScanNet++或复制上. 我们两个模型都是不可知的 每个实例都带有相同的标签,因此每个查询的类头只预测查询是对象还是没有对象,而不是200ScanNet200类中的一个.

blocks.en:
We evaluate on the 50 official validation scenes of ScanNet++ v2 and on the 8 Replica scenes, taking the vertices of the ground-truth meshes as input points.
The ground-truth instances are the objects of the 84 instance classes of the ScanNet++ top-100 benchmark and of the 48 Replica classes that OpenMask3D and Open-YOLO3D evaluate.
Walls, floors, ceilings, and other structural elements carry no instance.
Both models predict 100 masks per scene at 2 cm voxels, without DBSCAN, NMS, or a score threshold.
We treat all instances as one class and report the ScanNet AP averaged over IoU thresholds from 0.5 to 0.95, together with AP 50 and AP 25 .
Instances and predictions with fewer than 100 points are ignored, and a prediction that lies mostly on unlabeled points is not counted as a false positive.
blocks.zh:
我们评价了ScanNet++ v2的50个官方验证场景和8个复制场景,把地面-真相网的顶点作为输入点.
地面真实实例是ScanNet++顶-100基准的84个实例类别和OpenMask3D和Open-YOLO3D评价的48个复制类别的对象。
墙壁、地板、天花板和其他结构要素没有实例。
两种模型都预测每个场景的口罩为2cm voxels,没有DBSCAN,NMS,或者分数阈值.
我们把所有情况都作为一类处理,并报告ScanNet AP平均高于IOU阈值0.5至0.95,以及AP50和AP25。
低于100分的事例和预测被忽略,一个大多位于无标签点上的预测不算作假阳性.

blocks.en: Figure A5 shows qualitative class-agnostic instance segmentation results.
blocks.zh: 图A5显示定性类不可知实例分解结果。

blocks.en: Figure A5 : Qualitative class-agnostic 3D instance segmentation on ScanNet++ and Replica.

blocks.en:
We study open-vocabulary instance segmentation with OpenMask3D [ 69 ] and Open-YOLO3D [ 12 ] , using the same training data as the class-agnostic experiments ( Table A2 ).
For OpenMask3D and Open-YOLO3D, only the class-agnostic Mask3D proposal network is retrained on each dataset, and the training-free labeling step is unchanged.
We evaluate on the same 8 Replica scenes with the 48 classes and the 200 posed RGB-D frames per scene released by Open-YOLO3D.
Both methods receive the 100 masks per scene of the retrained Mask3D.
We follow the evaluation of both papers and report AP averaged over IoU thresholds from 0.5 to 0.9, and AP 50 .

blocks.en:
The robot is a Franka arm on a holonomic base, simulated in MuJoCo, and the demonstrations are recorded at 20 Hz with a wrist camera and a camera on the base, both at 240 × \times 320.
The state holds the arm joints, the gripper, and the base velocity.
The action holds the arm joint targets relative to the current joints, an absolute gripper command, and a base target pose relative to the current base pose.

动作与当前关节相对持有臂联目标,绝对握手命令,而基目标相对于当前基位的姿势则呈现.

We fully fine-tune all four models from their released checkpoints for 120k steps on four GH200 GPUs and keep an exponential moving average of the weights. π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} trains with a total batch size of 256 and the other models with 128, depending on the model size and the chunk size.

blocks.en: Appendix F Monocular depth and normal estimation
blocks.zh: 附录F 单体深度和正常估计

blocks.en: We additionally provide benchmarks for monocular depth and normal estimation, evaluating existing state-of-the-art models in a zero-shot setting on the Physicl Scenes test set ( Tables A3 to A5 ).
blocks.zh: 此外,我们还为单体深度和正常估计提供了基准,在Physicl Scenes测试集(表A3至A5)的零射程中评价现有最新模型。

blocks.en:
We use the same test frames as the single-view inverse rendering benchmark ( Section E.1 ), 1,820 frames at 640 × \times 480, mixture of day and night lighting.
Every method receives the same tone-mapped sRGB image and runs with its released code and weights.
Methods that accept camera intrinsics run both without and with the ground-truth intrinsics (GT K K ), and the other methods only without.
Metric3Dv2 needs the focal length to recover metric scale, so we report its metric depth only with the ground-truth intrinsics.
blocks.zh:
我们使用与单视反向渲染基准(E.1节)相同的测试帧,1,820帧,时间为640×\times 480,昼夜照明混合.
每个方法都得到相同的音调映射的sRGB图像,并随其发布的代码和重量运行.
接受照相机内含的方法既无地面真实性(GT K K),也只有其他方法。
Metric3Dv2需要焦距以恢复度量尺度,所以我们只报告其度量深度的地真内在.

blocks.en:
We score only pixels with reliable geometry, which excludes glass, mirrors, the sky, surfaces closer than 0.3 m, and a one-pixel image border, and we score depth only up to 20 m.
For metric depth ( Table A5 ), we score the raw prediction.
For relative depth ( Table A4 ), we fit a scale and a shift per frame by least squares, in depth space for methods that predict depth and in disparity space for methods that predict disparity, and clip the aligned depth to [0.001, 20] m.
Methods that predict metric depth also enter the relative table after this alignment.
For normals ( Table A3 ), we compute the angular error in degrees between the predicted and ground-truth normals in the camera frame, without any alignment.
We compute every metric per frame and average it over all frames of both lightings.
blocks.zh:
我们只得有可靠几何的像素,这不包括玻璃,镜像,天空,表面接近0.3米,以及一个像素的图像边框,我们得分深度只有20米.
对于度量深度(表A5),我们得分为原始预测。
对于相对深度(表A4),我们按最小的方块,在深度空间中,为预测深度的方法和预测差异的方法在差异空间中设置一个比例尺和每个帧的偏移,并将对齐深度缩短到[0.001,20]米。
预测测量深度的方法也在此对齐后输入相对表.
对于常态(表A3),我们计算相机框中预测的和地面真实的常态之间的角度误差,而没有任何对齐.
我们计算每个帧的每个度量, 并平均它在所有帧 两种照明。
